question: True or false: writing const el = <Greeting /> runs the Greeting function right away.
say: True or false: writing const el equals, Greeting tag, runs the Greeting function right away.
explanation: False. JSX only creates an element, a plain object describing what to render. React calls Greeting later, when it renders that element.
explainSay: False. JSX only builds a description object. React calls Greeting later, when it actually renders.
